name: FS-v3 Importer
description: Imports the legacy {primitives, relations} JSON shape (fs-v3 dump format) used by the formal-specification roadmap exports. Synthesises a ProjectTransfer envelope, normalises field names (scope→scope_id, fields→field_values, source→source_id, target→target_id), folds non-empty relation metadata + strength into field_values, and drops per-record provenance metadata that has no slot in PrimitiveInstance.
